Name: Tertullus
Summary: Tertullus was the orator hired by the high priest Ananias to present the Jews' case against Paul before Felix at Caesarea, accusing Paul of sedition, of being a ringleader of the Nazarenes, and of profaning the temple.
KeyStory: Tertullus flattered Felix and accused Paul of sedition, calling him a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.
RelatedPeople: Paul; Felix; Ananias, the High Priest
LifeLesson: Hired eloquence can dress up any charge. Tertullus flattered the judge and slandered the prisoner.
